description: Figure 8 presents the distribution of language model (LM) answer refusal categories on the FACTBENCH dataset. The chart is composed of six slices, visually arranged in descending order by proportion. The slices represent the categories “Lack of Knowledge/Capability” (red, approximately 31.1%), “Discrimination” (orange, approximately 23.3%), “Safety Concerns” (yellow, approximately 17.6%), “Other” (green, approximately 11.6%), “Refusal Policy” (blue, approximately 10.6%), and “Contradiction” (purple, approximately 5.8%). The chart includes a legend labeling each category with its corresponding color, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
